paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : Gemini-Pro
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how the metric labeled “Informativeness” changes across five discrete x-axis positions for two methods, “0-CoT” and “CoRe.” The x-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and shows integer tick marks from 0 to 4 at an interval of 1. The y-axis is labeled “Informativeness,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.910 to 0.962 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.910, 0.920, 0.930, 0.940, 0.950, and 0.960 (interval 0.010). The “0-CoT” series is drawn as a blue dashed line with circular markers, starting near 0.959 at x=0, decreasing to about 0.952 at x=1, about 0.934 at x=2, about 0.919 at x=3, and ending near 0.911 at x=4. The “CoRe” series is drawn as an orange solid line with upward-pointing triangular markers, starting near 0.961 at x=0, decreasing to about 0.949 at x=1, about 0.935 at x=2, about 0.920 at x=3, and ending around 0.914 at x=4.
